rules: Do not use a technology-basis embodiment to change the confirmed transit-family operator.
Do not infer a race-specific FTL family from its technology basis alone.
Every generated embodiment must retain status and provenance for family identity, basis mapping, race override and tier upgrade separately.
Higher Path/tier output must identify which upgrade-vector terms changed and which equation/control constraint thereby improved.
The same environment must be permitted to help one family and harm another, especially around gravity gradients, shear lanes and reference-poor space.
Safety horizon must not be treated as perfect; sensing, solving, command latency, field response and exit time remain finite.
